title: The US DOJ says at least two DOGE employees accessed Social Security data that was off-limits under a court ruling and shared agency data on third-party servers (April Rubin/Axios)
summary: April Rubin / Axios: The US DOJ says at least two DOGE employees accessed Social Security data that was off-limits under a court ruling and shared agency data on third-party servers — - At least two DOGE employees, the filing reveals, were in touch with a political advocacy group that asked them to analyze data …
